name: bootstrap

description.en: The bootstrap route seeds a venue only with the right secret and is idempotent.
description.uk: Маршрут bootstrap наповнює заклад лише з правильним секретом і є ідемпотентним.

probe: Box only. No secret -> 404; wrong secret -> the same 404 body; the right secret with a non-bundle body -> 400 'bad bundle' (the secret matched, nothing written). The idempotent re-seed half (0.1.0) is NOT run: it would rewrite the QA catalogue with replace semantics.
